| Building: Retail fit-out: Class 6 | Planning pathway: Development application (DA) | Procurement route: Design and construct; no automatic later appointment or novation. |

Conditions that apply: Work to an existing building; Site stays occupied or operating during the works; Delivered in stages.
Conditions that do not apply: Several buildings or a campus; Parts with different NCC classes.

### 2. Scope of services

You advise on access for each appointed stage, from our written instruction to your final report and response round. Designers keep design responsibility, the BCA consultant coordinates the code strategy and the certifier decides compliance. Your advice does not guarantee approval or protect against a discrimination complaint.
Issue each review as a dated PDF report with marked-up drawings and an editable register of issues, Performance Solutions and evidence, recording location, drawing revision, owner, due date and close-out. Coordinate with the architect, landscape, civil, services, lift, fire and BCA consultants.
Assessment basis: The uses and classes in section 1, against the current NCC, its livable housing requirements where housing is included, and any council adaptable-housing target. We provide the survey, approvals and conditions; tell us what is missing.

Select base, options and end boundary; advice-only ends at its report/response round. Later work needs written activation. R1 Fee by stage: Price each selected stage/service: basis, quantity, ex GST/GST/total; base/options/alternatives and standalone/package dependency separate. State milestones/validity; acknowledge addenda and authorised signatory. Price each included stage. A line marked Included is part of its stage fee; a line marked Excluded is not part of this appointment. Fees exclude GST; state GST and total in your proposal. Propose any departure in R6.

### 4. Allowances

Complete quantities or authorised assumption with owner/date/consequence. Fixed fee, time ceiling or unit rate/quantity; base/options and standalone/package dependencies separate.

| Item | Allowance |
|---|---|
| Coverage | 2 buildings/uses/floors/units/routes/sample areas; measured versus visual evidence, inaccessible areas and safe-access provider |
| Reviews / reports | 2 packages/rounds by stage; preliminary/final mark-ups, draft/final reports, client and authority responses |
| Meetings / RFIs | 2 meetings by stage/duration/location; RFI hour ceiling and tender period. Reconcile stage counts/concessions and disclose conflicting totals |
| Solution options | 2 departures/groups, briefs/reports, consultations/revisions, independent review and completion checks |
| Tests / visits | 2 visits allocated by selected stage: inspections/pre-final/final/revisits/handovers; separate test methods/locations/quantities/provider, equipment and certificate gaps |
| Duration / extras | 2 months; travel/out-of-hours, delay/remobilisation/cancellation; extra review/meeting/visit/departure units |

### 5. Terms

- Engagement under attached Project access appointment (attached), agreed schedules, numbered addenda and written acceptance; settle precedence/departures. No commencement, boilerplate or correspondence silently settles conflicts or activates work.
- Written authority before extra scope, overrun, rate/fee/time change: reason, output, price and program effect. Agree law/interpretation changes, delays and staged releases against baseline.
- Sign-off records baseline; agreed design development/routine coordination remain included. Inputs need revisions/owners/dates; missing evidence/access promptly flagged.
- Correct own errors without extra fee. Reasonable professional skill/care within competence; evidence limits do not waive agreed responsibilities.
- Payment 30 days after correct invoice for agreed services; GST/stage milestones separate. Declare deposits, final-report release, interest and suspension departures.
- State fixed rate period and proposed changes; disclose travel, portals/invoice formats, cancellation/remobilisation before appointment; no hidden uplift.
- Valid 90 days; reconcile conflicting offered validity, program, meeting and liability terms. Missing agreement or revised attachment is not acceptance.
- Send questions in writing to Project manager by 2026-10-23.
- Issue scope answers as numbered addenda to all tenderers; acknowledge each.
- Agree project/team/authority/operator use and explicit third-party reliance, editable files/retention/handover and confidentiality. R6 declares caps/time bars, indemnities, IP limits, caveat/security and retrospective terms; agree law/disputes/cure/termination.
